defs.def: to support the weight of sb/sth and take them or it from place to place; to take sb/sth from one place to another 拿；提；搬；扛；背；抱；运送

ex.s: The fuels for transport need to be not just green, cheap and powerful, but also lightweight and safe enough to be carried around.
ex.t: 这种"服装即服务"模式顺应了更广泛的共享经济潮流。

ex.s: Why did Blue Hill carry out the experiment?
ex.t: Blue Hill为什么要进行这次实验？

ex.s: Her ____22____ came because she was carrying a ____23____ across the finish line.
ex.t: 她的____22____是因为她正带着一位____23____冲过终点线。

ex.s: The twins carried the breakfast upstairs and woke their mother up.
ex.t: 双胞胎把早餐端上楼叫醒了母亲。

ex.s: carry out hypnosis training
ex.t: 进行催眠培训

ex.s: 26 Why did Bridges carry out the project?
ex.t: 26 布里奇斯为什么要开展这个项目？

ex.s: To carry out programmes    D.
ex.t: 电子邮件：humanresources@glodeve.org

ex.s: As one group of workers carried out the rubbish, another group began removing seats and other theater equipment in preparation for the building’s end.
ex.t: 当一组工人运走垃圾时，另一组工人开始拆除座椅和其他剧院设备，为建筑的终结做准备。

ex.s: It’s hard for writers because endings carry so much weight with readers.
ex.t: 对作家来说这很难，因为结局在读者心中分量太重。

ex.s: Either your shopping is then too heavy to carry home   57   you can’t use what you’ve bought while it’s still fresh.
ex.t: 要么你买的东西太重，搬不回家____57____，要么你买的东西还没来得及趁新鲜用掉。

ex.s: Bailey then ____27____ to let Lenoue climb onto her back and carried her all the way to the finish line, then another 300 feet to where Lenoue could get ____28____ attention.
ex.t: 贝利随后____27____让勒努爬上她的背，一路背着她到了终点线，然后又走了300英尺，到了勒努能接受____28____救治的地方。

ex.s: Mik was carrying 30 kilos on his head!
ex.t: 米克头顶上扛着30公斤！

defs.def: to have sth with you and take it wherever you go 携带；佩戴

ex.s: They may carry diseases.
ex.t: 它们可能携带疾病。

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

ex.s: Please carry your card with you at all times.
ex.t: 请随时携带你的卡。

ex.s: Unfortunately, you must carry the necessary equipment with you, since it’s all but impossible to find natural substitutes.
ex.t: 遗憾的是，你必须随身携带必要的设备，因为几乎不可能找到天然的替代品。

defs.def: to contain and direct the flow of water, electricity, etc. 输送，传输，传送（水、电等）

ex.s: As I carried her up the blackberry-lined path toward my car where I kept a water bottle, she began to move.
ex.t: 当我抱着她沿种满黑莓的小路走向停着水瓶的车时，她开始动了起来。

ex.s: I've driven teams of horses and carried water.
ex.t: "我出生在威斯康星州的乡村。

ex.s: The rainfall carries heat into the ground.
ex.t: 当我沿着黑莓丛小路走向停着车的、放着水瓶的地方时，它开始动了。

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。

ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 这项由哥伦比亚气候学院及其他机构的科学家开展的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中沿用过去的树种模式，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平最多将上升30%。

defs.def: if a person, an insect, etc. carries a disease, they are infected with it and might spread it to others although they might not become sick themselves 传播；传染

ex.s: They should also prepare plenty of reusable bags to carry their "new" clothes home.
ex.t: 他们还应该准备大量可重复使用的袋子，把"新"衣服运回家。

ex.s: The island is also home to the Charles Darwin Research Station, where 3________studies are carried out.
ex.t: 该岛也是查尔斯·达尔文研究站的所在地，那里进行3____研究。

ex.s: Almost everyone these days carries a mobile phone with them.
ex.t: 如今几乎人人随身带着手机。

ex.s: This is why, in part at least, the US National Climate Assessment says that: ＂There is no ‘one-size fits all’ adaptation.＂ Nevertheless, there are some actions that offer much and carry little risk or cost.
ex.t: 这就是为什么，至少部分地，美国《国家气候评估》说：“没有‘一刀切’的适应。”尽管如此，有些行动收益大、风险和成本却小。

ex.s: Readers are often carried away by character.
ex.t: 读者经常被角色所感染。

defs.def: to be able to remember sth 能记住；能回想起

ex.s: Armed with  this  knowledge. they're able to carry out individually targeted campaigns to cheat people.
ex.t: 掌握了这一知识，他们就能开展有针对性的个人化活动来欺骗人们。

defs.def: to support the weight of sth 支撑；承载

ex.s: It carries more wisdom and knowledge.
ex.t: 它承载着更多的智慧和知识。

ex.s: As Tan once said, Chinese music should carry “universal expression” of the human spirit so as to be recognised by the whole world.
ex.t: 正如谭（盾）曾说，中国音乐应当承载人类精神的“普遍表达”，从而被全世界所认识。

ex.s: By the time 250,000 were on the bridge, engineers noticed something terrible：the roadway was flattening under what turned out to be the heaviest load it had ever been asked to carry.
ex.t: 等到25万人在桥上时，工程师们注意到一件可怕的事情：桥面在它迄今承载的最重负荷下变平了。

defs.def: to accept responsibility for sth; to suffer the results of sth 承担（责任）；承受（结果）

ex.s: It carried more weight than it could.
ex.t: 它承受了超出其能力的重量。

defs.def: to have sth as a quality or feature 具有（某品质或特点）

ex.s: This is why decorating with plants, fruits and flowers ___62___ (carry) special significance.
ex.t: 这就是为什么用植物、水果和鲜花装饰___62___（具有）特殊意义的原因。

defs.def: to have sth as a result 带有，带来（某种结果或后果）
if sth that is thrown, kicked, etc. carries a particular distance, it travels that distance before stopping 扔（或踢等）到 … 距离

ex.s: It didn’t take long before they walked through the front door carrying a big box.
ex.t: Poppy像往常一样欢迎他们回家，但当她看到盒子时，停了下来。

ex.s: Dr Prinstein has also found that the qualities that made the neighbors want you on a play date-sharing, kindness, openness — carry over to later years and make you better able to relate and connect with others.
ex.t: 普林斯坦博士还发现，那些让邻居愿意和你一起玩的品质——分享、善良、开放——会延续到以后 years，使你更好地与他人建立联系和沟通。

ex.s: A study carried out by some of its researchers several years ago concluded that city trees did release isoprene.
ex.t: 几年前该机构一些研究人员开展的一项研究得出结论：城市树木确实会释放异戊二烯。

ex.s: My legs carried me to that door, and I pushed it open.
ex.t: 我的腿把我带到那扇门前，我把它推开了。

ex.s: In this way, they know how it feels to walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles.
ex.t: 通过这种方式，他们体会到背着沉重的水瓶走长距离是什么感觉。

ex.s: She said, "I've had a lot of clouds, but I've had so many rainbows," and that she always carried the "rainbows" with her to her speeches and classes.
ex.t: 她说：“我遇到过很多阴云，但也有许多彩虹，”而且她总把那些“彩虹”带在身边，带去她的演讲和课堂。

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。

ex.s: At the end of each session I return home feeling stronger, lighter, more able to carry on.
ex.t: 每次课程结束时，我回到家感觉更强壮、更轻松，更能继续下去。

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费杂货罐回来，我爸爸评论说，我到处带着罐子真是傻。

defs.def: if a sound carries, it can be heard a long distance away 传得很远

ex.s: Anniversaries and birthdays carry even more weight in long-distance friendships.
ex.t: 虽然技术可能使日常交流成为可能，但在特殊日子付出额外的努力会有很大帮助。

defs.def: to take sth/sb to a particular point or in a particular direction 向 … 前进；推进到

ex.s: One of his friends had stopped to make a bicycle repair, but they had encouraged Mac to carry on, and they would catch up with him soon.
ex.t: 他的一个朋友停下来修自行车，但他们鼓励麦克继续前进，说很快就会赶上他。

defs.def: to approve of sth by more people voting for it than against it （以多数票）获得通过
to win the support or sympathy of sb; to persuade people to accept your argument 赢得 … 支持（或同情）；劝说 … 接受论点

ex.s: A survey carried out last year showed that 80% of the middle-aged in this city ______ in favour of the proposal on health care reform.
ex.t: 去年进行的一项调查显示，该市80%的中年人___支持医疗改革的提案。

defs.def: to have a particular label or piece of information attached 贴有（标签）；附有（信息）
if a newspaper or broadcast carries a particular story, it publishes or broadcasts it 刊登；登载；播出；报道
if a shop/store carries a particular item, it has it for sale 销售；出售
to be pregnant with sb 怀孕；怀胎
to hold or move your head or body in a particular way 保持姿态；做姿势
to add a number to the next column on the left when adding up numbers, for example when the numbers add up to more than ten 进位

ex.s: Even when serving in the US Army during the Second World War, he carried six chapters of The Catcher in the Rye with him and worked on the novel throughout his war service.
ex.t: 即使在二战期间服役于美国陆军时，他也随身带着《麦田里的守望者》的六章手稿，在整个服役期间都在创作这部小说。

defs.def: to win sth 赢得；获得
to succeed in doing sth that most people would find difficult 成功地对付，不费劲地处理（大多数人认为难以应付的事）

ex.s: I thought ___18___ myself, “Why would he carry all his books? ” Just then, some kids ran at him, ___19___ (knock) his books out of his arms.
ex.t: 我想,____18____“为什么他要带着他的书?” 刚才,一些孩子冲着他,____19____他的书从他的怀里跑出来。

defs.def: to continue moving 继续移动

ex.s: She is determined to carry on with her  66  (educate).
ex.t: 她决心继续她的  66  （educate）。

defs.def: to argue or complain noisily 争吵；吵闹；吵闹地抱怨
to do sth that you have said you will do or have been asked to do 履行；实施；执行；落实
to do and complete a task 完成（任务）

ex.s: In the final chapter of part one, I’ll guide you through carrying out your own digital declutter.
ex.t: 在第一部分的最后一章，我将指导你完成自己的数字清理。

ex.s: In one experiment carried out at the National University of Singapore, participants were given the task of learning concepts on a difficult subject.
ex.t: 在新加坡国立大学进行的一项实验中，参与者被赋予学习一门困难学科概念的任务。

defs.def: to keep sth from one situation and use it or deal with it in a different situation 运用；应用
to delay sth until a later time 延迟；延期
